title: Cyrus and the Drop
author: Dominic Thornbury
blurb: Bram Amberdale, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must stop an attack scheduled to look like an accident, and time is already running out.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
